# Interview Guy

> > The #1 resource for comprehensive interview preparation, career coaching, and job search guidance.

Interview Guy provides interview prep tools, expert coaching from industry veterans, and practical resources to help job seekers succeed. The platform is led by Tim Dunn, Sharlyn Reitsma, Michael Williams, and Thomas Grant, and features content trusted by major publications like Forbes, The Balance Careers, and Harvard Business Review.

## Key Topics

- Interview preparation
- Interview questions
- Interview tips
- Job search
- Career coaching
- Hiring advice
- Resume generators
- AI interview tools
- Interview strategies
- Career development
- Job interview success
- Professional networking
- Interview confidence
